commits.message:
[GPU] Canonicalize ttg.warp_id in single-warp execution regions (#12885)

#12876 adds a special case to the `tcgen05` MMA lowering for contexts
with 1 warp. However, I would expect `WarpIdOp` to always canonicalize
away in 1 warp partitions and shouldn't need a special case.

It turns out that `NVGPUToLLVM` has a canonicalization for this but
since #9535, it now runs after partitions have already been flattened so
never fires unless the entire kernel is single warp.

This PR moves the canonicalizer into `ttg.warp_id` itself, and also
registers that pattern to run during the `CanonicalizeLLVMIR` pass,
which runs before warp specialization lowering when the partitions are
still distinct.

commits.message:
[FPSAN] compact_exp2 and probability_cast for shard-invariant attention  (#12881)

Online softmax can center the same score around different maxima when
the number of shards changes. The merge compensates with `alpha =
exp2(local_max - global_max)`. An ordinary FPSan downcast mixes the
weight before that correction, so equivalent FP8 implementations can
produce different signatures.

This adds an opt-in FPSan encoding that lets the correction commute with
the FP8 conversion. Call `fpsan.compact_exp2` for the centered
probabilities and their correction factors, then mark the cast and the
operand that reads the probabilities.

```python
alpha = gl.fpsan.compact_exp2(old_max - m)
weights = gl.fpsan.compact_exp2(scores - m[:, None])
p = gl.fpsan.probability_cast(weights, gl.float8e4nv, expect_zero=mask)
p_mem.store(p)
tcgen05_mma(p_mem, v_mem, acc, a_type="fpsan_probability", mbarriers=[done])
```

Both `tcgen05_mma` and `tcgen05_mma_scaled` accept the tag. Use `b_type`
for a right operand, or `gl.fpsan.probability_cast(p, gl.float32)` to
widen in registers. The producer writes one byte per weight. The
consumer's static tag tells FPSan how to decode the byte it actually
reads from SMEM or TMEM. This makes copies, aliases and intervening
writes observable through the existing memory operations and eliminates
producer tracing and probability shadow storage. In a separate Triton
merge kernel, compute the weight with `tl.fpsan.compact_exp2(local_max -
global_max)`. Native execution uses the regular `exp2`, FP8 conversion
and MMA.

#### Encoding and limits

The compact FP32 exponential uses `E(x) = (1 + 2^25)^x mod 2^32`. Its
128 distinct powers fit in a byte alongside a separate code for masked
zero. Widening recovers the power multiplied by an odd format-specific
marker `t`. Thus `t E(s - m) E(m - M) = t E(s - M)`, and the signature
records the FP8 cast. Other nonzero inputs map to a disjoint set of
lossy codes. For a tagged block-scaled operand, FPSan applies the block
scale to the expanded payload in the FP32 ring. Shard invariance assumes
each token retains its scale across the comparison. Recomputing block
scales from shard-dependent weights can change the quantization.

Each `compact_exp2` call selects the compact algebra for that
expression. Exponent differences divisible by 128 hide a missing
correction, and differences divisible by 64 hide a reversed correction.
Accumulation can also cancel differences.

#### Tests

- Compare 1, 2 and 4 shards with an independent full-width integer
reference for both SMEM operand positions and a reinterpreted TMEM score
allocation, including a scaled MMA with alternating block scales. Check
the numerator and denominator, including masked tokens.
- Check that missing and reversed corrections, ordinary `exp2` for the
merge correction, dropping a token, extra narrowing, overwriting the
tile, omitting the consumer tag and using an ordinary cast change the
result for the test inputs. Compare against the uncast reference as
well.
- Check E4M3 and E5M2 round trips across all 128 powers, masked zero and
native parity. Check ordinary `exp2` on the same input against its usual
FPSan reference in the same kernel.
- On GB300 the Gluon FPSan suite passed (267 passed, 118 skipped, 1
expected failure). Compute Sanitizer memcheck passed all six new cases
with zero errors. Four related lit tests and pre-commit passed.

commits.message:
[NVIDIA] Use K96 automatically for eligible single-CTA scaled FP4 MMA (#12875)

Enable K96 for single-CTA scaled FP4 MMA on SM103 in the existing
backend lowering from #11438. With a K tile of 256, both CTA groups can
issue 96 + 96 + 64. The decision belongs to the compiler and uses the
operand descriptors and scale layout. The typed operation is identical
under FPSan. Reassociation can change floating-point rounding on
hardware.

A narrow RHS needs a different scale-stride check for the single-CTA
form. With N=64, packing 64 scale rows into TMEM gives a two-column
stride between successive scale words. Single-CTA K96 needs a
four-column stride. The packed layout uses K64, while a padded 128-row
scale allocation can use K96. A regression exercises both layouts with
distinct powers of two for each scale group and checks both the product
and the instruction count.

The GPU cases cover NVFP4 and MXFP4, K tiles of 128, 256 and 512, and N
tiles of 64, 128 and 256. They compare eligible tiles bitwise with the
paired-CTA result. GB200 uses K64 on the same source. A direct hardware
probe on GB200 raised an illegal instruction when forcing K96. [PTX
ISA](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/parallel-thread-execution/index.html#tcgen05-matrix-shape)

commits.comment:
【变更意图】修复 ConSan（Concurrency Sanitizer）与 Membar 对共享内存复用顺序的不一致：Membar 依赖 atomic/reduce/layout conversion 等 op 在 lowering 时隐式发出的 cluster barrier 来保证共享内存复用的顺序，但 ConSan 只记录显式的 ttng::ClusterBarrierOp，因此在 lowering 已经同步过的情况下仍可能对后续复用同一段共享内存的访问报 outstanding access 误报。
【实现方式】(1) 在 ConSanTargetHooks 新增虚方法 getClusterBarrierStages(Operation*) -> BarrierStages（默认返回空），由 ConSanNVIDIA 覆写为转发 ttng::getClusterBarrierStages（来自 Membar 分析）；(2) AuxDataMap 把原先的 internalClusterBarriers 列表替换为 operations 快照 SmallVector<pair<Operation*, BarrierStages>>，在 populateAndPassToWarpSpecialize 中遍历全部 op 记录其 barrier 阶段，并对有 barrier 或显式 ClusterBarrierOp 的 op 分配 cluster barrier slot；(3) instrumentMemoryOperations 从 entryPoint.walk 改为遍历快照，抽出 rendezvous lambda 在不同阶段插入 createClusterBarrierRendezvousCall：beforeMemoryEffects（或在显式 ClusterBarrierOp 时）在 op 前插入、betweenMemoryEffects 在 op 前（已发布本地 scratch 写之后）、afterMemoryEffects 在 op 之后插入，publishVisibility 取 stages.hasBarrier()；这同时消除了原来"先收集 cluster barrier 再二次遍历插入"的绕行做法。(4) PrepareConSanCaptures 在有 cluster barrier 的模块上，用 Analysis/CallGraph.h 的 CallGraph<int>::walk<PostOrder> 后序遍历调用链，若被调函数内部（含跨调用）存在显式或隐式 cluster barrier，则移除该函数的 noinline 属性，使 Gluon inliner 把私有 helper 内联、从而让 ConSan 沿执行流看到隐式 barrier。(5) CUDABackend 中把 gluon.add_inliner 调整到 add_prepare_consan_captures 之后，配合(4)的 noinline 移除生效。
【潜在风险】(a) 依赖 CallGraph 遍历去 noinline 会改变函数的 inline 决策，可能影响 ConSan 模式下生成代码的形态（但仅在 consan 使能时）；(b) AuxDataMap 语义从"仅记录 sanitizer 内部 barrier"改为"快照全部 op + barrier 阶段"，getClusterBarrierSlot 之类按 op 查 slot 的调用点需与 operations 快照保持一致，否则可能拿不到 slot（此处对显式 ClusterBarrierOp 分支仍单独处理）；(c) BarrierStages 的字段语义（before/between/afterMemoryEffects 与 hasBarrier）与 Membar 分析强耦合，后续修改 Membar 阶段划分会同步影响 ConSan；(d) 仅 NVIDIA hook 实现了 getClusterBarrierStages，其他 target 默认为空，等价于保持旧行为，风险可控。
【测试】新增 test_shared_reuse_after_implicit_cluster_barrier 覆盖 release/acquire/reduce 三种 atomic/reduction 隐式 barrier 下共享内存复用的场景，验证 ConSan 不再误报。

commits.message:
[ConSan] Model implicit cluster barriers during shared-memory reuse (#12868)

Membar relies on cluster barriers emitted by atomics, reductions, and
layout conversions to order reuse of shared memory. ConSan only records
explicit cluster barriers, so it can report an outstanding access when a
later allocation reuses bytes that the lowering has already
synchronized.

Use Membar's barrier stages to publish visibility at the corresponding
point in ConSan. When a private helper contains an implicit barrier, let
the existing Gluon inliner expose it so ConSan follows the executed
control flow.

commits.message:
[Analysis] Prove ring cursors with matching steps disjoint (#12866)

The pipeliner carries the read and refill indices of a shared-memory
ring in separate SSA values. In a three-slot ring with a two-iteration
prefetch, the read visits slots `0, 1, 2` while the refill visits `2, 0,
1`. Membar currently inserts a barrier between these accesses because
their indices have different SSA bases.

Record a cursor's starting slot and step modulo the ring size when all
entry edges agree on the seed and all backedges agree on the step.
Cursors of the same block with equal steps preserve their initial
separation. This lets Membar omit the barrier between the read and
refill within an iteration while still ordering the next iteration's
refill against the current read.

The proof assumes that signed `i32` additions in slot indices and cursor
updates fit in range.

commits.message:
[ConSan] Only fence visible cp.async writes (#12812)

A proxy fence for one shared tile can execute while `cp.async` is still
writing another. ConSan previously credited the fence for both tiles and
accepted a subsequent TMA read of the copied tile without a post-wait
fence.

Mark a `cp.async` destination unpublished at issue when tracking proxy
fences. At a fence, use the fencing thread’s write visibility to
determine which generic writes it covers. `wait_group(N)` already
publishes exactly the buffers selected by its completed-group mask.
Observing the same copy again through a group wait also preserves a
valid fence after an earlier mbarrier wait.

commits.message:
[NVIDIA] Elide the warp-zero predicate for single-warp tcgen05 MMA (#12876)

An MMA in a single-warp execution region already has exactly one issuing
warp. The warp-zero predicate introduces a warp ID calculation and a
branch in the inner loop of a warp-specialized GEMM. Use the region's
warp count to elide the check there. The caller's predicate, lead-CTA
check and lane election still control which thread issues the
instruction. This applies to scaled and unscaled tcgen05 MMA.

The lowering test checks that a one-warp NVFP4 MMA branches directly on
the caller's predicate. In a GB300 experiment with a one-warp MMA
partition and K96 enabled, the generated kernel went from three shuffle
instructions to two. Across five projections with reused operands,
throughput relative to an inline-PTX implementation went from 0.980× to
1.003× (geometric mean of paired CUDA graph timings). The benchmark uses
the opt-in K96 change in both compiler variants. This patch can be
reviewed and applied independently.

[BAKCEND] Expose bulk L2 prefetch in NVIDIA Gluon (#12867)

Add `hopper.bulk.prefetch(pointer, num_bytes, pred=True)` so Gluon

commits.message:
[Pipeliner] Derive power-of-two cp.async slots from the induction variable (#12848)

For a power-of-two `cp.async` load ring, an `i32` loop induction
variable with a constant odd step visits every slot from any starting
index. Compute the read and refill slots from that induction variable
using separate `arith.remui` operations. Pipeline expansion shifts each
operation to its stage, and the remainder lowers to a bit mask.

We keep this conservatively to powers of two because it regresses perf
for other cases in small matmuls.

Teach `BufferIndexAnalysis` to recognize unsigned remainders with a
power-of-two modulus so Membar can prove that accesses with different
offsets use different slots within an iteration.

commits.comment: 修复 TMA store 的 shared-memory source 在其 completion wait 之前若 SSA 最后一次使用是 store 就会被分配器回收、与 layout conversion scratch 复用的正确性 bug：给 TTNG_TMAStoreWaitOp 增加 Variadic<TTG_MemDescType>:$deps 以及旧签名的 builder 重载，assemblyFormat 加可选 deps 段；TMALowering 的 lowerTMAStore 把 local_alloc 传入 wait 的 deps。Gluon 的 tma.store_wait / bulk.store_wait 增加 deps 参数并透传到 create_async_tma_store_wait；大量示例、tutorial、translator 与测试把 _keep_alive() 改为 deps=[...]。这是 API 扩展（新增可选参数，保留旧重载），但 Gluon store_wait 的签名新增关键字参数会要求用户迁移以正确保活，属于行为层面的半 breaking（旧的 store_wait(0) 仍可编译但不再自动保活）。改动面广但机械，风险中等；test_frontend 中的期望 IR 已更新为带 deps。

ascend_impact.functionality: 无影响。TTNG_TMAStoreWaitOp 属 NVIDIA 方言，Gluon 的 tma/bulk store_wait 是 NVIDIA 专有前端；Ascend 不使用这些路径。
ascend_impact.testing: 无影响。所有测试改动均在 python/test/gluon、python/tutorials/gluon、test/TritonNvidiaGPU 等 NVIDIA 路径。

commits.message:
[NVIDIA] Keep TMA store sources live through the completion wait (#12865)

A TMA store can still be reading its shared-memory source when a layout
conversion runs between the store and its wait. If the store is the
descriptor’s last use in SSA, the allocator can assign those same bytes
to the conversion’s scratch buffer and corrupt the data written to
global memory.

Pass the source descriptor to `ttng.async_tma_store_wait` when lowering
descriptor stores. The wait becomes a use of the allocation, keeping its
storage live through completion. Gluon callers can express the same
dependency with `tma.store_wait(0, deps=[src])` or `bulk.store_wait(0,
deps=[src])`.

commits.comment: 修复 NVMMA shared layout 在 transposed 视图下 box 重复顺序不一致导致 tl.dot 读错行的问题：getOrder 对 NVMMASharedEncodingAttr 改为始终使用 rowMajor 的 getMatrixOrder(shape.size(), true)，transposed 时在 rank 范围内把第一个 layout 轴旋转到前面（跳过 pipeline stages）；buildNvmmaSharedLinearLayout 用 getOrder 推导 order，reverse 后对 outDimNames 与 tmaShape 统一 applyPermutation，去掉原本特鲁的 rotate/transposeLinearLayout/swap collapsedTmaShape 逻辑，末尾改为 LinearLayout(reshapedLayout.getBases(), boxNames)。单测 LeadingOffset_64x4x32 transposed 的基底期望值随之更新，并把 dim1 从 64 改为 512 以覆盖多 box 场景，test_lowerings 参数化新增 (512,64,32) 情形。属于 TritonGPU NVMMA layout 的通用修复，Ascend 不走 NVMMA shared layout。

ascend_impact.functionality: 无影响。NVMMASharedEncodingAttr 与 LinearLayoutConversions 的服务对象是 NVIDIA/AMD 的 TTGIR 布局，Ascend 跳过 TritonGPU 布局阶段直接走 Linalg/HIVM。
ascend_impact.testing: 无影响。单测在 unittest/Dialect/TritonGPU 与 python/test/gluon。

commits.message:
[NVIDIA] Fix the axis order of transposed NVMMA shared layouts (#12864)

When both axes of an NVMMA shared tile span multiple TMA boxes, the
plain layout and its transposed view can repeat the boxes in different
orders. This makes `tl.dot` read elements from the wrong rows.

Use the physical axis order for both the box shape and its dimension
names. The boxes then repeat in the same order in both orientations, so
each shared memory offset maps to the permuted coordinates of the source
at every rank.

Thanks to @bhargavchintam for the reproducer and diagnosis.

Closes #12672 and fixes #12671.

commits.comment: 更彻底地修复 OptimizeAccumulatorInit 的累加器优化正确性：findZeroInitOp 现在要求 loop-carried arg 只有一个 use（即 MMA 的 use-accumulator 位置）且 for 的对应 result 在循环后无 use，否则放弃把 reset 折叠进 useAcc 标志；同时新增 yield 值只有一个 use 的要求，避免 reset 之后还有其它消费者。原先在 pass 顶层用 accArg + result 非空就整体放弃的粗略检查被移除。核心思想是显式刻画两种 folding 形态（reset 在 MMA 之后 vs 之前），注释给出了精确的 IR 形状。测试大幅重写 test_tma_matmul_accumulator_intermediate_read，新增 before_dot/after_reset/next_iteration 三种 snapshot 变体并参数化 reset_period/reset_value/snapshot/store_after_loop 组合，并按 num_stages 区分。属于 TritonGPU 优化 pass 的正确性修复，逻辑清晰但条件收紧可能损失部分优化机会。

ascend_impact.functionality: 无影响。OptimizeAccumulatorInit 属 lib/Dialect/TritonGPU/Transforms，作用于 Blackwell tcgen05 MMA 的 useAcc 折叠，Ascend 不走该路径。
ascend_impact.testing: 无影响。测试在 python/test/unit/language/test_matmul.py 且 skipif 非 Blackwell。
